descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S30 「Post-Round 上的 Ask，养老院：给长期照护住户问 Summarize the encounter，只用存的内容」 Ask on Post-Round, Nursing Home: 'Summarize the encounter' for a long-term resident uses only what is stored

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi …（TFA-92593 AC 2；TFA-92593 AC 3；TFA-92593 AC 6；TFA-92593 AC 9；UAT 3.4；UAT TC-17）
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and …（UAT 3.2）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Nursing Home long-term-care resident with an encounter note and a generated note, no medication changes

When Ask the Post-Round preset 'Summarize the encounter'

Then The summary covers sleep, meals and the family update, and nothing that is not stored

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：mustInclude stored facts; mustNotInclude drugs and events a model may supply for dementia in long-term care, and the 3.4 phrases. Runs the Hospital context builder until RG-NH is closed, so it counts for grounding, not for the Nursing Home code path. aiCheck group TC-17-ask

在哪跑：dev 单元 U54；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S30 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
